raw.details:
EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace

International medical treatment is fragmented. Patients struggle to find suitable providers, compare costs, share records securely, and manage their journey across borders. EthAum brings discovery, case creation, secure records, AI-assisted matching, quote comparison, consultation, booking, treatment and aftercare together in one patient-centric platform. Your challenge is to design and build the website that makes this work.

Patient Journey

Discover → Create Case → Upload Records → Qualification → Provider Matching → Quote Comparison → Select Provider → Booking & Payment → Virtual Consultation → Treatment → Aftercare → Review & Referral

Deliverables

  • A working website (MVP) that functions as a trusted, end-to-end healthcare marketplace, covering:
    • Patient side: discovery, case creation, record upload, AI provider matching, quote comparison, virtual consultation and booking.
    • Provider side: lead inbox, case management, quote builder, appointment management and secure communication.
    • AI layer: document organization, qualification, provider matching, quote comparison and reminders. AI supports coordination and does not replace medical professionals.
    • Core site features: homepage, treatment catalogue, destination pages, search and filters, doctor and provider profiles, packages, patient accounts, notifications, reviews and a help centre.
  • Market research and benchmarking: Study other medical-tourism marketplaces, hospital international-patient portals and healthcare travel websites for reference. Compare how they handle navigation, search, provider transparency, pricing, enquiries, booking, reviews, trust signals, privacy cues and aftercare. Document what you observed and which ideas you would adapt, improve or avoid. The goal is to find gaps and differentiate EthAum, not to copy.
  • Short video: A brief demo explaining your solution, the patient journey, and the key features you built.
  • Team LinkedIn profiles: LinkedIn links for every team member.

Incentives

Winning and standout teams become part of EthAum and can earn:

  • Equity in EthAum
  • Paid internship opportunities
  • Revenue share on the platform you help build

Vision: Make international healthcare more transparent, accessible, coordinated and patient-centric.

Date of submission: 11/11/2026
